scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents - Haryana Labour Welfare Board
description:
The Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents scheme is an initiative launched by the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

This scheme was introduced to provide financial support to workers in the unorganized sector who require a tricycle for their livelihood.

The scheme aims to enhance the mobility of workers and their dependents by providing them with a means of transportation.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board launched this scheme on 1st April 2018.

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance for the purchase of tricycles to workers who are physically challenged or have dependents who are physically challenged.

The scheme specifically targets individuals who are engaged in various forms of labor but lack the financial means to acquire a tricycle.

Eligible beneficiaries under this scheme include workers who are registered with the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The scheme also extends to dependents of registered workers who are physically challenged and require a tricycle for mobility.

To qualify for the scheme, applicants must be residents of Haryana.

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years.

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for this scheme.

The income criteria for eligibility stipulate that the annual income of the applicant should not exceed INR 1,00,000.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is capped at INR 25,000.

This amount is intended to cover the costs associated with purchasing a tricycle.

The application process for this scheme is straightforward and involves several steps.

Interested applicants must first obtain the application form from the Haryana Labour Welfare Board's official website or their local office.

The completed application form must be submitted along with the required documents.

Required documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhar card or voter ID.

Applicants must also provide proof of residence in Haryana.

A certificate of disability is required for physically challenged applicants or their dependents.

Additionally, applicants need to submit their income certificate to verify that their annual income does not exceed the stipulated limit.

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the officials of the Haryana Labour Welfare Board.

The review process typically takes about 30 days from the date of application submission.

If the application is approved, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the beneficiary's bank account.

The disbursement of funds is usually completed within 15 days of approval.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is responsible for implementing this scheme.

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana.

For any inquiries regarding the scheme, beneficiaries can contact the Haryana Labour Welfare Board at their official helpline number.

The helpline number is 1800 180 2087.

The scheme has been positively received by the public since its launch.

Many beneficiaries have reported improved mobility and enhanced opportunities for employment.

The Haryana government has allocated a budget of INR 5 crore for this scheme for the financial year 2023-2024.

This budget is aimed at providing assistance to approximately 2,000 beneficiaries.

The scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to support the welfare of laborers in the state.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has been proactive in promoting this scheme through various outreach programs.

The board conducts awareness campaigns to inform potential beneficiaries about the benefits of the scheme.

These campaigns are aimed at ensuring that eligible workers and their dependents are aware of the assistance available to them.

The scheme is also aligned with the government's goal of promoting inclusivity and accessibility for persons with disabilities.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board regularly updates its website with information regarding the scheme.

This includes details about the application process and any changes to eligibility criteria.

The board also encourages feedback from beneficiaries to improve the scheme.

Since its inception, the scheme has seen a steady increase in the number of applications received.

In the first year alone, over 1,500 applications were processed.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board has established a dedicated team to handle queries related to the scheme.

This team is responsible for providing assistance to applicants throughout the application process.

The board has also partnered with local NGOs to reach out to potential beneficiaries.

These partnerships have helped to identify workers who may not be aware of the scheme.

The Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents scheme is a crucial step towards empowering workers in Haryana.

By providing financial assistance for mobility, the scheme aims to improve the quality of life for many individuals.

The Haryana government continues to monitor the impact of the scheme on the lives of beneficiaries.

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the effectiveness of the scheme.

The findings from these assessments are used to make necessary adjustments to improve the scheme.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board is committed to ensuring that the benefits of the scheme reach the intended recipients.

This commitment is reflected in the board's efforts to streamline the application process.

The board also aims to reduce the turnaround time for disbursement of funds.

Overall, the Financial Assistance for Try Cycle to Workers and their Dependents scheme represents a significant initiative by the Haryana government.

It reflects the government's dedication to supporting the welfare of its labor force.

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also promotes dignity and independence among workers and their dependents.

In conclusion, the scheme is a vital resource for many families in Haryana.

It addresses the unique challenges faced by workers who are physically challenged.

The Haryana Labour Welfare Board continues to play a pivotal role in implementing this scheme effectively.
